title: Featured card across the whole row
summary: grid-column: 1 / -1 makes one item span every column, from the first line to the last.
explanation: Grid lines are numbered from 1 at the start edge. The last line is -1, whatever the number of columns, so grid-column: 1 / -1 always runs from the first line to the last.
This works inside an auto-fit grid too. The featured card stays full width while the rest of the cards keep reflowing around it, so the layout still adapts to the preview width.
tryThis: Change the featured card to grid-column: 1 / 3: it now spans two columns instead of the full row.
Remove grid-column from .featured and see it shrink back to one cell.
Narrow the preview and watch the cards reflow while the featured one keeps its full width.
